description: Paid endpoint ($0.01): Hyperliquid whale positions closest to liquidation across all coins: address, coin, side, notional, leverage, liquidation price, mark and distance %, for the top ~150 accounts by value. Filters: max_distance_pct (default 10), side, coins, min_usd (default 100k), limit 1-100. Adds notional at risk per distance bucket and per coin. Bad params 400, stale 503, no charge. Returns the x402 payment requirements and URL.
name: get_whale_liq_distance
title: Hyperliquid whales nearest liquidation (paid, x402) — $0.01

x402.behavior: Tool returns x402 payment requirements + URL; caller pays over HTTP with own wallet. Charged only on HTTP 200.
